facebook.content:
My dear child, I want you to know that you are not alone. When trials and doubts come, don't let them whisper lies in your ear. Remember who you are – a beloved child of the Most High. You are strong, you are capable, and you are worthy.

Don't let the enemy steal your peace. Speak the truth over yourself. Say it with me: "I am loved. I am accepted. I am enough."

You are not a victim of your circumstances. You are a victor, a conqueror, a warrior of God.

Now, I want to hear from you.
